title: Schema Model Materialization
description: Materialization Configuration. The incremental object form accepts `format` (delta_lake | hive | iceberg), `partitions`, `strategy`, `database`, and the physical-layout tuning fields `bucket` and `sorted_by`. DJ translates `bucket` / `sorted_by` into the correct Trino table properties per format: Iceberg emits bucket transforms inside `partitioning` plus a standalone `sorted_by`; Hive / Glue emits `bucketed_by` + `bucket_count` + `sorted_by`; Delta Lake supports neither and DJ flags it.
